title: 第13章  阳册奥秘，你要了我吧
slug: 让你当炉做鼎你炼阴阳证大道
content_zh:
李寒山不敢再分心，闭上眼，任由那股温和的力量牵引着自己的神魂，一寸寸地淬炼、壮大。
“好了。”
不知过了多久，洛璃松开手，额头沁出细密的汗珠，小脸却带着笑意：“大爷，你的神识已经比之前强了一倍不止。以后那妖女再对你施展魅术，你应该能察觉到了。”
李寒山睁开眼，感应着脑海中那团清晰无比的神识之力，心中震撼不已。
“丫头，谢谢你。”
他真诚地看着洛璃，千言万语汇成一句。
这个梦里的丫头，才是真正无条件对他好的人。
“哦，对了，大爷，我再教你一门神识攻伐术，接下来我可能要闭关一段时间，就怕修炼得太投入，错过了大爷的梦....”
洛璃没有浪费时间，继续教了起来，直到梦境破碎。
他的意识从梦境中抽离，身体各处的知觉如水漫般涌回。
李寒山睁开眼，入目便是花弄影那张倾国倾城的脸。
她侧躺在旁，一只手撑着脑袋，另一只手轻轻搭在他胸口，睡颜恬静。
李寒山没有动，用神识扫了一下周围。
方圆百米内的一切，尽收“眼底”。
隔壁房间，两个婢女正在熟睡；院子外面，几只灵雀在树枝上跳跃；更远处，山间的灵气如薄雾般缓缓流动。
“这....”
李寒山心中一惊。
他记得很清楚，突破炼气四层时，神识只能覆盖方圆十米左右。就算炼气六层了，也不过二十几米。可现在修为没变，神识覆盖范围竟然暴涨到了百米？这可是炼气九、十层的水准了！
也就是说，他的修为虽然还是炼气六层，神识却堪比炼气圆满，不比花弄影差了！
神识增强只是表象，更大的好处在于神魂。

他能感觉到，自己的神魂比之前强了数倍，仿佛从一汪小水潭变成了一座湖泊，浑厚而凝实。
“丫头......”
李寒山心知，这一切都得益于洛璃的帮助与付出。她甚至主动用自身魂力来滋养他的神魂，否则单凭一门炼神术，哪能有这般奇效？
修炼到最后，他能明显感觉到洛璃变虚弱了，心里越发过意不去。
“他日我若崛起，今日之恩，必当百倍相报！”
李寒山在心中默默起誓。
这些都是后话，现在的他，还有花弄影这把悬在头顶的达摩克利斯之剑，连能不能活下来都成问题。
“主人，你醒啦～”
花弄影的声音软糯糯地响起。
她睁开眼，长长的睫毛颤了颤，脸上绽开明媚笑容：“主人，你这次又睡了三天三夜呢。奴家都快担心死了。”
“三天三夜？”
李寒山一愣，随即心中了然。
他进入梦境的时间，跟身体的承受极限有关，在修为增强后，却还是三天。这么看。梦境的极限可能就是三天。
“主人，你没事吧？”
花弄影凑近了些，小手探上他的额头，美眸中满是关切。
那关切太真了，真到李寒山差点又信了。
不过，这次他清晰感知到，一股极其微弱的精神波动，从她身上散发出来，无声无息地往他脑海里钻。
这应该就是她施展的魅术了。
以前他神识太弱，完全察觉不到。现在神识暴涨，这魅术在他面前，就像黑夜中的萤火虫一样显眼。
“我没事。”

李寒山不动声色，叹了一口气：“就是做了一个很长的梦，这是我从小得的怪病，一直不见好。”
“什么梦呀？”
花弄影好奇。
“记不清了。”
李寒山笑了笑，起身穿衣。
花弄影也不追问，乖巧地帮他整理衣襟，温柔得像个小妻子。
李寒山任由她服侍，心中却在盘算。
现在他能抵御魅术了，但这远远不够。花弄影是炼气大圆满，他是炼气六层，差距摆在那里。一旦她绕开或者干脆不顾心魔誓约翻脸，他依旧没有胜算。
必须找到破局之法。
“主人，今天天气不错，要不要出去走走？”
花弄影帮他穿好衣服，挽住他的胳膊。
“好。”
李寒山点头。
两人走出院子，沿着山路散步。
阳光透过树叶洒下来，在地上投下斑驳光影。山间灵气随着微风轻轻流动，让人心旷神怡。
李寒山一边走，一边将神识外放，感知着周围的一切，这种方式可以加强对神识的操控。
突然，他的神识无意中扫过自己的小腹，意外有了发现。
那里，阳纹在亮起后，他的神识竟能够进入其中。然后便探到里面存在着一个隐秘的空间。
不大，约莫一间屋子大小，四周弥漫着金色的雾气。雾气中央，有一朵含苞待放的花，花瓣紧闭，散发着古老而神秘的气息。
“这是....”

李寒山心中一震。
他仔细感知，发现那朵花共有九片花瓣，此刻全部紧紧闭合，一片都没有开。
他试着用神识触碰那朵花。
一股信息如潮水般涌入脑海。
阳册功法，阴阳相生，纹开则神通现。
阳纹与阴纹，本为一体。阳纹为主，阴纹为奴。阴纹花开，则奴契初成；阳纹花开，则主契大成。
花开九瓣，一瓣一重天。
一瓣开，可感奴之心绪；三瓣开，可断奴之生机；六瓣开，可掌奴之神魂；九瓣开，则阴阳合一，奴不死，主不亡。
李寒山倒吸一口凉气。
这阳册功法，竟然还藏着这样的秘密！
也就是说，他可以通过阳纹，控制花弄影。
但前提是！阳纹的花必须开。
而花开，需要他与花弄影修炼的时候，使用阳册功法从她体内汲取一些本源。如此一来，每修炼一次，纹路就会深一分，离花开就更近一分。
直到阳纹的第一片花瓣完全绽开，他就能感应到花弄影的心绪。
“原来如此。”
李寒山心中大喜。
他终于找到了破局之法！
只要继续与花弄影修炼，让阳纹的花瓣绽开，他就能逐渐掌控这个妖女。到那时，她就算突破筑基，也翻不出他的手掌心！
“主人，你在想什么呢？”
花弄影的声音在耳边响起。

李寒山回过神，发现她正歪着脑袋看他，眼中带着几分好奇。
“没什么。”
他笑了笑，伸手揽住她的腰：“在想你。”
花弄影脸一红，轻轻锤了他一下：“主人，你什么时候也变得这么油嘴滑舌了～”
李寒山哈哈大笑。
他决定了，继续配合花弄影，该修炼修炼，该亲热亲热。表面上，他正一点点被她魅术迷惑；暗地里，他会借助阳册一步步加深阳纹，等待花开的那一天。
“可惜，没有早点发现。”
之前的修炼，主要以提升修为为主，李寒山没有刻意去加深纹路。
现在么，每一次修炼，他都会悄无声息的从花弄影体内汲取一些身体本源，这会大大加快花开的速度。
接下来的日子，一切如常。
花弄影依旧温柔体贴，李寒山依旧“沉迷”其中。
每次与花弄影修炼完毕，他都会用神识仔细观察腹部的阳纹。
那朵花，正在一点点绽放。
第一片花瓣，从紧紧闭合，到微微张开，再到张开一半.....
至于花弄影那边，她的阴纹在不断加深，但花瓣没有开放的迹象，这并不重要，关键是李寒山的阳纹。
仅仅几天后。
李寒山体内传来一声闷响，修为突破到了炼气七层。
与此同时，他的腹部一热，那朵花的第一片花瓣，终于完全绽开了！
一股玄妙的感应，在他心头升起。
他闭上眼，凝神感知。

渐渐地，他“听”到了花弄影的心绪！
那是一种复杂的情绪，有恨意，有贪婪，有算计，还有一丝.....说不清道不明的东西。
但唯独，没有真心。
“果然。”
李寒山心中冷笑。
这妖女，从来没有真正臣服过他。她所做的一切，都是为了魅惑李寒山，直到他彻底中招，她便可以反客为主，借助他突破筑基，再一举将他的阳册功法弄到手。
不过没关系。
一片花瓣开了，很快就会有两片、三片、四片.....
总有一天，他会让这朵花完全绽放。到那时，花弄影就再也翻不出他的手掌心了。
事实上，只需要开到第三片，就可以控制花弄影了。
三片断生机，六片掌神魂。花弄影的修为不高，无须开到第六片。
这天下午，李寒山正在林间练习神识攻伐术，一个熟悉的身影从山路上走来。
“李爷爷！”
许灵溪远远地招手，小脸上满是欣喜。
李寒山收回神识，迎了上去。
“灵溪，你怎么来了？”
“我想你了呀～”
许灵溪蹦蹦跳跳地跑过来，一把抱住他的胳膊，笑靥如花。
李寒山打量了她一眼，不由一愣。
“炼气四层？这么快？”

“嗯！”
许灵溪重重点头，小脸上带着几分得意：“师父说我极阴之体修炼速度本来就快，再加上她给我服了不少丹药，所以就......嘿嘿～”
李寒山由衷地为她高兴：“不错不错，照这个速度，用不了多久你就能超过我了。”
两人说笑了一阵，许灵溪突然压低声音，道：“李爷爷，我这次来，是有正事要跟你说。”
“什么事？”
许灵溪左右看了看，确认没人后，才小声道：“我帮李爷爷打听过了，炉鼎也可以转为正式弟子。”
“真的么？”
李寒山眼睛一亮。
“真的！”
许灵溪认真道：“有两个条件。第一，炉鼎的主人同意，再交一笔赎身费；第二，需要参加宗门考核，通过后就能成为外门弟子。”
李寒山心中大喜。
如果能成为正式弟子，无疑要主动得多。万一花弄影这边提前翻脸，他还可以找机会逃出去！
“不过......”
许灵溪话锋一转，小脸垮了下来：“师父说，李爷爷你年岁太大了，又惹到了赵元这个外门执事，想转为外门弟子极难。”
李寒山问：“为什么？”
许灵溪叹了口气：“师父说，外门弟子的考核是由赵元负责的，外门长老与他关系也不错，他肯定会从中作梗，况且就算成了，以后也会被赵元针对。”
不消许灵溪说，李寒山都知道，这家伙百分百要针对自己，毕竟赵元可是准备杀了他的。
李寒山问：“还有办法么？”
许灵溪点头：“还有，那就是让某个长老看上，收为亲传弟子，就像我这样。但....师父说李爷爷太老了，不会有长老看中的，除非对方别有用心。”
好吧，年龄大是原罪，李寒山内心里再度吐槽起这草蛋的穿越。

“所以......”
她咬了咬唇，艰难地开口：“李爷爷你只有一条路可以走，那就是成为内门弟子。”
“内门弟子？”
李寒山一愣。
“嗯。”
许灵溪点头：“内门弟子不归赵元管，他插不上手，最近刚好有一次机会。”
“什么机会？”
“宗门大考。”
许灵溪道：“每次宗门大考，内门弟子都要进入秘境试炼。如果炉鼎选择赎身参加，并且通过试炼，就可以直接成为内门弟子。”
她抬起头，眼中满是担忧：“但师父说，这样的秘境试炼，对内门弟子来说都极其危险。更别说李爷爷你是炉鼎了。那些内门弟子肯定会针对你的。”
李寒山沉默了。
内门弟子，至少都是炼气后期。他一个炼气七层，还是炉鼎身份，进去之后，怕是会被吃得连骨头都不剩。
“而且.....”
许灵溪咬了咬唇：“师父说，秘境试炼之中，不管是做什么都不犯规，包括自相残杀。”
李寒山脸色一沉。
这哪里是试炼，分明是养蛊。
“李爷爷....”
许灵溪抓住他的手，眼眶红红的：“要不....你要了我吧？”
“什么？”
李寒山一愣。

许灵溪的脸红得像要滴血，声音小得像蚊子叫：“我是极阴之体，李爷爷你是纯阳之体。如果我们……你的修为肯定能冲上去。到时候进秘境，就有把握了。”
她说着说着，眼泪掉了下来：“我不想看着李爷爷死……我、我愿意的……”
content_en:
Li Hanshan did not dare to be distracted anymore, closed his eyes, and allowed the gentle force to pull his soul, tempering and growing inch by inch.
"Okay."
After an unknown amount of time, Luo Li let go of her hand, beads of sweat appeared on her forehead, but there was a smile on her face: "Uncle, your consciousness has become more than twice as strong as before. You should be able to notice when the enchantress casts a spell on you in the future."
Li Hanshan opened his eyes, feeling the clear power of consciousness in his mind, and was shocked in his heart.
"Girl, thank you."
He looked at Luo Li sincerely and said a thousand words into one sentence.
The girl in this dream is the one who truly treats him unconditionally.
"Oh, by the way, uncle, I will teach you another spiritual consciousness attack technique. I may have to retreat for a period of time. I am afraid that I will be too involved in practice and miss the uncle's dream..."
Luo Li didn't waste time and continued teaching until the dream was shattered.
His consciousness was withdrawn from the dream, and all the sensations in his body came back like water.
Li Hanshan opened his eyes and saw Hua Nongying's alluring face.
She lay on her side, supporting her head with one hand and gently placing her other hand on his chest, sleeping peacefully.
Li Hanshan did not move and scanned the surroundings with his spiritual consciousness.
Everything within a hundred meters radius can be seen.
In the next room, two maids were sleeping soundly; outside the yard, several sparrows were jumping on the branches; further away, the spiritual energy in the mountains was flowing slowly like mist.
"This..."
Li Hanshan was shocked.
He remembered clearly that when he broke through the fourth level of Qi Refining, his spiritual consciousness could only cover a radius of about ten meters. Even if he reaches the sixth level of Qi Refining, he is still only twenty meters away. But now that the cultivation level has not changed, the coverage area of ​​​​the spiritual consciousness has suddenly increased to 100 meters? This is the level of the ninth or tenth level of Qi refining!
In other words, although his cultivation level is still at the sixth level of Qi refining, his spiritual consciousness is comparable to that of Qi refining perfection, no worse than Hua Nongying!
The enhancement of spiritual consciousness is only an appearance, the greater benefit lies in the soul.
He could feel that his soul was several times stronger than before, as if it had changed from a small pool into a lake, thick and solid.
"Girl..."
Li Hanshan knew that all this was due to Luo Li's help and dedication. She even took the initiative to use her soul power to nourish his soul. Otherwise, how could a divine refining technique alone have such a miraculous effect?
At the end of the training, he could clearly feel that Luo Li had become weaker, and he felt increasingly regretful.
"If I rise in the future, I will repay today's kindness a hundredfold!"
Li Hanshan swore silently in his heart.
These are all things for later. Now it is doubtful whether he and Hua Nongying, the Sword of Damocles, can survive.
"Master, you're awake~"
Hua Nongying's voice sounded soft and waxy.
She opened her eyes, her long eyelashes trembled, and a bright smile appeared on her face: "Master, you slept for three days and three nights again this time. The slave family is almost worried to death."
"Three days and three nights?"
Li Hanshan was stunned for a moment, and then he understood.
The time it took for him to enter the dreamland was related to his body's endurance limit. After his cultivation increased, it was still three days. Look at it this way. The limit of dreams may be three days.
"Master, are you okay?"
Hua Nongying came closer and put her small hand on his forehead, her beautiful eyes full of concern.
The concern was so genuine that Li Hanshan almost believed it again.
However, this time he clearly felt an extremely weak mental wave radiating from her body and silently entering his mind.
This should be the charm she cast.
In the past, his consciousness was too weak to notice it at all. Now that his consciousness has surged, this charm is as conspicuous in front of him as a firefly in the dark night.
"I'm fine."
Li Hanshan remained calm and sighed: "I just had a long dream. This is a strange disease I have had since I was a child, and I have never recovered."
"What dream?"
Hua Nongyingcurious.
"Can't remember clearly."
Li Hanshan smiled and stood up to dress.
Hua Nongying didn't ask any further questions, and obediently helped him tidy up his clothes, as gentle as a little wife.
Li Hanshan allowed her to serve him, but he was making calculations in his heart.
Now he could resist the charm, but it was not enough. Hua Nongying is at the Great Perfection of Qi Refining, and he is at the sixth level of Qi Refining. The gap is there. Once she bypasses her or simply ignores her inner demons and turns against him, he still has no chance of winning.
A way out of the situation must be found.
"Master, the weather is nice today, do you want to go out for a walk?"
Hua Nongying helped him get dressed and held his arm.
"Okay."
Li Hanshan nodded.
The two walked out of the yard and walked along the mountain road.
The sun shines through the leaves, casting mottled light and shadow on the ground. The aura of the mountains flows gently with the breeze, making people feel relaxed and happy.
As Li Hanshan walked, he released his spiritual consciousness and sensed everything around him. This method can strengthen the control of his spiritual consciousness.
Suddenly, his consciousness swept across his lower abdomen and made an unexpected discovery.
There, after the Yang pattern lit up, his consciousness was able to enter it. Then he discovered that there was a secret space inside.
It's not big, about the size of a room, surrounded by golden mist. In the center of the mist, there is a budding flower with its petals tightly closed, exuding an ancient and mysterious atmosphere.
"This is..."
Li Hanshan was shocked.
He felt carefully and found that the flower had nine petals, all of which were tightly closed at the moment, and none of them were open.
He tried to touch the flower with his consciousness.
A flood of information flooded into my mind.
In the Yang book method, yin and yang complement each other, and when the patterns are opened, magical powers will appear.
The yang pattern and the yin pattern are originally one. The Yang pattern is dominant and the Yin pattern is slave. When the flowers in the yin pattern bloom, the slave contract is first completed; when the flowers in the yang pattern bloom, the master contract is completed.
The flower blooms with nine petals, one petal for the sky.
If one petal is opened, the slave's mood can be felt; if three petals are opened, the slave's vitality can be cut off; if six petals are opened, the slave's soul can be held; if nine petals are opened, the yin and yang are united, the slave will not die, and the master will not die.
Li Hanshan took a breath of cold air.
This Yang Book Cultivation Technique actually hides such a secret!
In other words, he can control Hua Nongying through Yang Mark.
But the premise is! The flowers in the Yang pattern must bloom.
As for Hua Kai, he needs to use the Yang Book technique to draw some of the essence from her body when he is practicing with Hua Nongying. In this way, every time you practice, the lines will become deeper and the flowers will bloom closer.
Until the first petal of Yangwen fully bloomed, he could sense Hua Nongying's mood.
"That's it."
Li Hanshan was overjoyed.
He finally found a way to break the situation!
As long as he continues to practice with Hua Nongying and let the petals of Yang Pattern bloom, he can gradually control this witch. By then, even if she breaks through the foundation, she still won't be able to get out of his palm!
"Master, what are you thinking about?"
Hua Nongying's voice rang in her ears.
Li Hanshan came back to his senses and found that she was looking at him with her head tilted, with a bit of curiosity in her eyes.
"Nothing."
He smiled and put his arms around her waist: "I'm thinking of you."
Hua Nongying blushed and gave him a gentle blow: "Master, when did you become so glib~"
Li Hanshan laughed.
He decided to continue to cooperate with Hua Nongying, to practice and be intimate when it was time. On the surface, he is being beguiled by her charm little by little; secretly, he will use the Yang book to deepen the Yang lines step by step, waiting for the day when the flowers bloom.
